evidence.quoted_text:
require(payload["record_after"]["sha256"] == payload["record_before"]["sha256"],
            "repeated recovery changed a rolled_back record")
evidence.reason: recovery_repeat only checks rc 2, the refusal text, and that the record hash is unchanged. It never snapshots or compares the restored service file, staged service path, or stable timer/unit activation before and after the repeat, so a repeat that mutates those while still refusing would pass. The existing fence helper for other refusals confirms the no-side-effect intent; the fix is a routine test assertion, excluding volatile completion logs as the finding says.
